name: Puffcloud · Gremlet #31
description:
A little cloud that came down to see what everyone was doing. Drizzles when it's moved.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Puffcloud in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
